We can book you a ride to a cooling centre on the hot days.
When we call we will say the words “tide cedar amber anchor” so you know it is really us. Ask us to say them.
The VA will never ask you to pay, wire money, or share bank details.
Report a suspected scam to VSAFE at 833-388-7233.
Veterans Crisis Line: dial 988, press 1.
